hints.title: SURVIVAL KIT
hints.text: The deepest mines add gas, floods and a tunnel borer. This lesson shows the gear that gets you through them. Dig east!

hints.title: REFUGE CHAMBER
hints.text: The steel chamber ahead is a refuge. Step inside and it saves your place: if you die later, you can respawn here for 100 points instead of starting again.

hints.title: GAS MASK
hints.text: The green cloud above is gas - without a mask it suffocates you in about three seconds. Take the masks, press 4 for 20 s of clean air, then climb in for the helium.

hints.title: NEVER LIGHT IT
hints.text: A blast that touches gas sets the whole cloud off. Keep dynamite and barrels well away from it - or use that on purpose, from a safe distance.

hints.title: PUMP
hints.text: The tunnel ahead is flooded. Take the pump, stand beside the water and press 5: it drains the flood and caps the spring that feeds it.

hints.title: A NEW REFUGE
hints.text: Each refuge you enter replaces the last one as your respawn point. Walk through this one before you meet the machine below.

hints.title: TUNNEL BORER
hints.text: The borer below grinds through rock and earth - and miners: touching it from any side is fatal. Wait in this shaft until it has rumbled past, then drop in behind it.

hints.title: IT SPARES ELEMENTS
hints.text: The borer leaves elements lying: the titanium is to the west, and the way out is a hole in the floor to the east. Stay well behind the machine - it turns round at each wall.

hints.title: READY FOR THE DEEP
hints.text: Refuges, gas, floods and the borer - you know every trick the mines have. Collect the iron and take the exit!
